acceptanceCriteria: Tests accept only complete exact-boundary Linux diagnostics: stable procfs.cwd PermissionDenied errno13 with observed matching pid/starttime/pgid/sid and a single-character state that may change, or the exact supplied procfs.fd-directory EACCES13 observed-before/unknown-after Uncategorized ESRCH3 diagnostic replay.

The existing cwd contains-based classifier is tightened as well as adding the fd case. Reject errno130, cwd-extra, missing/duplicate/extra fields, trailing text, PID prefix collisions, malformed identity, incomplete Some(uid), nested-only EACCES and wrong after identity/error. No catch-all Unknown acceptance.

RED proves the old classifier rejects the valid fd-directory ESRCH replay and incorrectly accepts errno130 and cwd-extra while the old stable cwd positive remains valid. Strict positive/negative matrix then passes GREEN.
A real formatter regression deterministically deletes only its fixture stat file to observe ENOENT/NotFound; it is never labeled kernel ESRCH reproduction and never broadens the classifier to ENOENT.

Private existing CompositionObservationHooks replay the supplied original line on a no-supervisor-receipt path. Assert actual spawn exit0, aggregate failure, Unknown, incomplete execution evidence, owned-tree termination unknown, Retained, cleanup None, actual worktree present and registered, and persisted JSON equality. This production fail-closed control stays GREEN.

Only crates/cockpit-verification/tests/composition.rs and existing Linux cfg(test) modules in crates/cockpit-verification/src/composition.rs may change. Production observer/types/permissions/cleanup/platform guards/public test-support/dependencies/generic frameworks remain unchanged.

Run targeted matrix, the original failed integration and complete declared workspace/all-target verification through current Runtime admission, with isolated target, one build job, writable HOME/TMPDIR, 900-second host cap and no independent procfs monitors during observation fixtures.
